privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: BrainRush AI (the app) is published by {{DEVELOPER_NAME}}. You can contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.

BrainRush AI works without collecting your personal data. There are no accounts, no advertising, no analytics, no crash-reporting services and no tracking in this version. The app is blocked from using the internet, so your information cannot leave your phone through the app.

To work, the app keeps the following in its private storage on your phone: an optional nickname, the topics you chose, your settings (theme, difficulty, daily goal, haptics, reminder time), and your scores, XP, level, streaks, achievements and activity history. We never receive this information and cannot see it.
None. We do not collect, receive, sell, rent or share personal information, device identifiers, advertising IDs, location, contacts, photos, files or usage data.

Vibration: to give touch feedback if you leave haptics on.
Notifications and boot completed: only if you turn on the daily reminder, so the reminder can be scheduled on your device again after a restart. The reminder is created locally and needs no internet or server.
The app does not request access to your location, camera, microphone, contacts, storage or network.

This version contains no third-party advertising, analytics or tracking software, and we share nothing with third parties. Google Play, which distributes the app, has its own privacy policy that applies to your use of the Play Store.
How long we keep data and how to delete it

Your data stays on your phone until you delete it. Go to Profile > Settings > Delete all my data to erase everything the app stored and cancel any reminder. Uninstalling the app also removes it. Because we hold no copy, there is nothing further to request from us.

Your data lives in the app's private storage area, which other apps cannot normally read. Because the app does not transmit data, there is nothing to intercept in transit. No method of storage is perfectly secure, so keep your phone protected with a screen lock.
BrainRush AI is intended for people aged 13 and over and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone, including children.

Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access, correct or delete on our side. You are in full control of the data on your device through Settings. If your local law gives you privacy rights, you can still contact us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with any question.
The app does not transfer data between countries because it does not transmit data.

If a future version adds features that handle data (for example advertising, cloud sync or online content updates), we will update this policy before releasing it, change the Google Play Data safety information to match, and ask for your consent where the law requires it. The date at the top shows when this policy last changed.

terms.title: Terms of Use
sections: BrainRush AI is provided for entertainment and personal mental exercise. By using it you agree to these terms.
The app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. We make no promise that using it improves intelligence, memory or any cognitive ability.
Questions are written and checked with care, but errors can occur. Tell us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} if you find one and we will correct it.
Please do not copy the app's content in bulk, reverse engineer it for the purpose of redistributing it, or use automated tools to inflate scores. Progress is stored on your device only.
We may update, change or discontinue features at any time. The app is provided as is, without warranties, to the extent permitted by law.

support.title: Help and Support
sections: Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and include your device model, Android version and what happened. We aim to reply within a few days.

Why did my streak reset? A streak continues when you finish at least one session with a correct answer each calendar day, using your phone's local date.

Why did a session give no XP? Sessions finished implausibly fast, and sessions after the daily XP limit, earn no XP. The Daily Challenge gives full XP once per day.

How do I move my progress to a new phone? Progress is stored on the device only in this version, so it cannot be transferred.

How do I delete my data? Profile > Settings > Delete all my data.
Send the question text and what you think the right answer is, and we will review it.

monetization.title: How BrainRush AI is funded
sections: BrainRush AI is free. There is no subscription and no in-app purchase.

This version shows no advertisements. If ads are added later, they will never appear during a question or puzzle, will respect your consent choices, and this page and the Privacy Policy will be updated first.
We do not sell data. This version does not collect any.
